task: Primitive-array collections: IntBitSet (rank/select/boolean ops) and open-addressing IntIntMap with backward-shift delete, differential and time-bounded tests
reasoning_summary: Backed a bit set by long[] words using shift-mod-64 and Long.bitCount for rank/select, and an int-int hash map by parallel arrays with linear probing and backward-shift deletion. Differential tests against java.util.BitSet/HashMap plus crafted colliding keys guard the delete logic. The only failure was a miscounted expectation in one hand-written test.
